messages.content: 曼聯的球員名單是什麼？

function.name: sports_team_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieve the top scorer of a sports team in a specific season. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team.description: The name of the sports team.

season.description: The season of interest, e.g. 2020-2021 NBA season.

league.description: The league the team is part of. Default is 'NBA'.

如果您想了解某位球員的具體數據（如進球、助攻等），請告訴我！
message.reasoning: The user asks "曼聯的球員名單是什麼？" which means "What is the player list of Manchester United?" They want the roster. We can use the function sports_team_get_top_scorer? That function retrieves top scorer, not full roster. There's no function for roster. So we need to answer manually. Provide current squad list. Use knowledge cutoff 2024-06. Provide list of players as of 2024. Let's provide a list of first-team squad. Also mention that it's subject to change.
